BOOK 3 — THE ECLIPTIC CIRCUS — WHAT'S DONE / WHAT REMAINS
STATUS: ~45% drafted. Chapters 1-7 exist in project knowledge; chapters 8-14 are unwritten.
• Ch1 The Tent That Wasn't There Yesterday — eclipse, tent appears, Jonas established as witness not subject. (CON-001 planted)
• Ch2 The Cold Reader — Jonas's clinical armour; he reads the audience.
• Ch3 Different Shows — witnesses report different performers; perception fractures.
• Ch4 — a file is referenced but did not surface in search; CONFIRM it exists / is complete.
• Ch5 The Second Performance — fear installed in the dark intervals; the Usher speaks to Jonas. (CON-004)
• Ch6 The Records Tent — Dara Osei's entry found; the Book of Names; 'I document, you document.' (CON-010, CON-008 seed)
• Ch7 Miriam's Entry — Jonas's late wife was a subject; the circus engineered him as its witness.
TO WRITE (Ch 8-14 — the back half, ~16,500 words):
• Ch8 Counter-Programme — Jonas works out how to counter-install; protects an audience member.
• Ch9 The Frequency Named — he identifies the signal beneath the circus AS The Frequency. (CON-001 — the spine connection)
• Ch10 Twelve Saved — he counter-programmes twelve people (matches Character Register: 'saves twelve people').
• Ch11 The Usher's Question — why a witness? the circus 'continues; it is getting better.'
• Ch12 Dara Unreachable — he cannot reach Dara Osei; explicitly hands the thread to Book 4. (CON-010 payoff sets up Bk4)
• Ch13 The Paper — Jonas publishes his account; it must be the document the 2157 archivist holds. (CON-012)
• Ch14 Eclipse Ends — the circus departs (will return for the next eclipse); Jonas permanently changed.
CONTINUITY MUST-HITS for the back half:
• CON-001: The Frequency must be explicitly named here (Bk3 is where the circus-signal = the universal Frequency lands).
• CON-010: Dara Osei's installed fear ('losing what she loves to those who won't value it') must be set up as her Bk4 condition.
• CON-012: Jonas's paper must be flagged as entering the 2157 archive.
• Character Register commits Jonas to: 'saves twelve people, publishes the truth.' Honour both.
• The Usher is NOT a villain — 'every line is a question that isn't phrased as a question.' Keep that voice.
BOOKS 4 & 5 — WRITING PLAN (the middle, plotted from known start + end)

WHY THEY'RE NOW PLOTTABLE: Bk1-2 (start) and Bk6 (end) are fixed. Bks 3-5 carry the Carriers from the keeper-houses/tribe toward the global Sealing. Each protagonist's work must end up in the 2157 archive (CON-012).
BOOK 4 — THE LAST LIBRARY (Dara Osei) — 12 chapters, ~27k:
Inherits from Bk3: Dara carries the circus-installed fear of losing what she loves to those who won't value it.
Arc (Character Register): 'Discovers the impossible geometry, burns the catalogue, protects the library.'
Must plant: CON-002 (books found by needing), CON-008 (Book of Carriers naming all four protagonists), CON-005 (Dara's 1923 portrait).
Must establish: CON-007 — the Library survives into 2157 and is the archivist's home.
Hands to Bk5: Eleanor-on-the-wall (CON-009) and the portrait (CON-005) recur inside the paintings of Echoes.
Ending: Thornfield dies peacefully knowing Dara's method worked; library stays open; Dara remembered, never named.
BOOK 5 — ECHOES OF THE FORGOTTEN (Isolde) — 15 chapters, ~31k:
The structural outlier: a crew/heist into painting-worlds (Isolde, Cutter, Davi, the Moth).
Arc: 'Discovers what she is; must choose whether to seal a world that contains her origin.'
Must plant/echo: CON-009 (Eleanor's name in many hands on a wall), CON-005 (Dara's portrait recurs, unrecognised).
The artifact = a mini-Sealing — retrieving it seals a painting-world (thematic rhyme with Bk6's true Sealing, CON-011).
Davi is the moral fulcrum: 'the only protagonist who can choose correctly because she has nothing to protect.'
Ending: all thresholds seal; the Moth sealed inside forever; Isolde seals her own origin; Davi's account → 2157 archive.

THEN: Book 6 is already ~55% drafted and is the convergence — finishing 4 & 5 means every protagonist's work exists to be the archivist's collection in the final beat (CON-012). The anthology closes on her.

RECOMMENDED WRITING ORDER: (1) finish Bk3 Ch8-14 — it's half-done and unblocks Dara's setup. (2) Bk4 full. (3) Bk5 full. (4) finish Bk6 Ch11-16. Write each chapter 1500-2500 words to hit targets; one connection-plant per the columns above.
